newsitem.title: USA: Speakers of U.S., Egyptian legislatures meet on peace.
newsitem.headline: Speakers of U.S., Egyptian legislatures meet on peace.

text.p: The Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives met the Speaker of Egypt's People's Assembly on Tuesday to discuss strengthening ties and the peace process in the Middle East.

The Egyptian official planned to brief House Speaker Newt Gingrich on "ideas and advice on how we can further the peace process in the Middle East and how we can build on what has become a firm friendship with the people of Egypt," the Georgia Republican said.
"We are here to express our feelings of friendship and cooperation between the two countries," Ahmed Fathy Sorrour, speaker of the People's Assembly in Egypt, said.
"I hope our meeting today we could change some views how to realise peace in the Middle East," he added.
Israel last week tried to enlist U.S. and Egyptian support for its efforts to pressure the Palestinian Authority to quell outbreaks of violence in the West Bank area of Hebron.
But Egypt last week said it was up to Israel to change its policies if Cairo's efforts to revive the talks were to succeed.
The peace talks collapsed in March after Israel angered Arabs by breaking ground on a new settlement in East Jerusalem.
